Velocity(벨로시티)는 1989년 호주 브리즈번 외곽의 뒷마당 창고: Velocity was born in 1989 in a backyard shed outside Brisbane, Australia. Founder Tom Black made aluminum water bottle cages by hand on his own, and his brother John Black took them to the United States. In 1991 Velocity introduced its first aluminum rim, the Aero, and became a rim brand.
1992년 미시간 그랜드래피즈에 미국 물류 센터를 열었고, 2012년에는: In 1992 Velocity opened a US distribution center in Grand Rapids, Michigan, and in 2012 it moved its entire Australian production to Jacksonville, Florida. Since bringing all production to Grand Rapids in 2016, Velocity remains one of the few brands making aluminum rims in the United States.

Roll, drill, anodize, build.<br/>압출부터 휠까:
Roll, drill, anodize, build.
From extrusion to wheel, under one roof.
그랜드래피즈의 Velocity 공장에서는 알루미늄 압출재를 둥글게 말고,: At the Velocity factory in Grand Rapids, aluminum extrusions are rolled into hoops, drilled for spokes and anodized for colour, then laced to hubs and spokes in the Wheel Department to become finished wheels. Good, locally sourced materials, and every step within arm's reach.
그래서 Velocity의 림은 고르는 재미가 있습니다. 같은 모델도 홀: That is why choosing a Velocity rim is fun. Each model comes in different hole counts, sizes, brake types and a range of anodized colours. Finding the right combination for your bike and your riding is where every Velocity wheel begins.
림을 해외에서 들여오는 것이 당연해진 시대에, Velocity는 알루미늄: At a time when importing rims is the norm, Velocity makes its aluminum rims in its own American factory.
휠 디파트먼트의 빌더가 스포크 장력과 진원, 디시를 하나씩 맞춥니다. 오: Builders in the Wheel Department set spoke tension, true and dish one wheel at a time. Wheels that last come from human hands.
블랙과 실버만이 아닙니다. Velocity의 컬러 림은 자전거에 개성을: Not just black and silver. Velocity's colour rims have become the easiest way to give a bike its own character.
픽스드 기어, 로드, 투어링, 그래블, 산악, 탠덤과 폴로까지. 거의 모: Fixed gear, road, touring, gravel, mountain, tandem and polo. There is a rim for almost every bike.
From the track to bikepacking, one rim for the way you ride.
높이 30mm의 딥 섹션 림. 트랙과 픽스드 기어, 도심 라이딩의 상징이: A 30mm deep-section rim. Velocity's signature model, an icon of track, fixed gear and city riding.
딥 V ATB를 다시 내놓은 림. 체중이 많이 나가는 라이더, 탠덤, 바: The Deep V ATB, reissued. The toughest choice for heavier riders, tandems and bike polo.
A23을 잇는 림 브레이크용 로드 림. 더 넓고 더 단단해졌고, 튜블리스: The rim-brake road rim that follows the A23. Wider, stiffer and tubeless capable.

A tough rim for touring and commuting. A long-lasting wheel for the bike you ride every day.
무거운 짐을 싣고 먼 길을 가는 투어링을 위해 만든 림. 700C와 65: A rim made for loaded long-distance touring. 700C and 650B.
가벼운 XC · 그래블 림 블런트 SS와 내폭 30mm 트레일 림 블런트: The light XC and gravel Blunt SS, and the Blunt 35 trail rim with a 30mm inner width.

The rim city fixed gear

Deep, stiff and built to last.
딥 V(Deep V)는 높이 30mm의 V자 단면을 가진 Velocity: The Deep V is Velocity's signature rim, with a 30mm-tall V-shaped profile. The stiffness of that deep section makes for strong wheels even with fewer spokes, and it stands up to the track, fixed gear and rough city streets for years. It comes with a machined brake track (MSW) or without (non-MSW), and in a range of anodized colours.
처커(Chukker)는 딥 V ATB를 다시 선보인 림입니다. 딥 V의: The Chukker is the Deep V ATB, reissued. Its deep profile is made even tougher to stand up to heavier riders, tandems and the constant knocks of bike polo.
V자 단면의 높이가 림 자체의 강성을 만듭니다. 스포크 장력이 고르게 유: The height of the V profile gives the rim its stiffness. Spoke tension stays even and the wheel stays true.
림 브레이크용으로 브레이크 면을 가공한 MSW, 픽스드 기어나 디스크 휠: Choose MSW, with a machined brake track for rim brakes, or the clean non-MSW finish that suits fixed gear and disc wheels.
블랙과 실버, 그리고 여러 컬러. 딥 V의 컬러 림은 픽스드 기어 문화의: Black, silver and many colours. The coloured Deep V became part of fixed gear culture.
딥 V의 형태를 더 튼튼하게 다듬은 처커는 탠덤과 폴로, 무거운 짐에 맞: The Chukker refines the Deep V shape into a heavy-duty rim for tandems, polo and heavy loads.

32H, 36H 등 (사이즈, 컬러에 따라 다름): 32H, 36H and more (varies by size and colour)
림 브레이크와 디스크,<br/>두 가지 답의 로드 림.<br/>넓게, 튜:
Rim brake and disc,
two answers for the road.
Wider, and tubeless.
The Quill follows the long-loved A23 road rim. Using design borrowed from the Aileron, it is wider and stiffer than the A23, with a 25mm-tall profile and a tubeless-ready bed. It is the Velocity that suits rim-brake road bikes and classic bicycles best.
에일러론(Aileron)은 디스크 브레이크 전용의 올라운드 로드 림입니다: The Aileron is a disc-only all-round road rim. Its 28mm-tall, 25mm-wide profile supports wide road tyres securely, and tubeless setup is simple. Road riding and light gravel on one wheelset.
A23의 다음 세대. 더 넓어진 폭과 높아진 강성, 튜블리스 레디. 림: The next generation of the A23. Wider, stiffer and tubeless ready. Velocity's answer for rim-brake road bikes.
디스크 브레이크 전용 로드 림. 로드 타이어부터 가벼운 그래블 타이어까지: A disc-only road rim. An all-round profile that supports everything from road tyres to light gravel tyres.
로드, 투어링, 올로드 (Aileron: 가벼운 그래블 포함): Road, touring, all-road (Aileron: including light gravel)
Quill 림 브레이크 / Aileron 디스크 전용: Quill rim brake / Aileron disc only
Loaded up,

클리프행어(Cliffhanger)는 투어링과 출퇴근을 위한 튼튼한 림입니: The Cliffhanger is a tough rim for touring and commuting. Its wide profile supports big tyres securely, and it can run tubeless for fewer flats. If you want a long-lasting wheel for the bike you ride every day, start with the Cliffhanger.
아틀라스(Atlas)는 이름처럼 무게를 짊어지는 림입니다. 패니어를 가득: The Atlas, as the name suggests, is a rim that carries the weight. It is made for long-distance touring with fully loaded panniers and comes in 700C and 650B. Built with 36 holes, it handles heavy loads and rough roads together.
짐과 라이더의 무게, 거친 노면의 충격을 함께 받아내도록 튼튼하게 설계했: Built tough to take the weight of rider and luggage and the shocks of rough roads.
투어링과 출퇴근에 쓰는 넉넉한 폭의 타이어를 안정적으로 받쳐, 낮은 공기: Securely supports the generous tyres used for touring and commuting, comfortable even at low pressure.
클래식 투어링 바이크부터 요즘의 650B 랜도너까지. 프레임에 맞는 사이: From classic touring bikes to modern 650B randonneurs. Choose the size that fits your frame.
길이 끝나는 곳에서<br/>더 넓어지는 림.<br/>그래블과 산, 그리고:
Rims that get wider
where the road ends.
Gravel, mountains and beyond.
블런트(Blunt)는 Velocity의 오프로드 림 패밀리입니다. 세 번: Blunt is Velocity's off-road rim family. The third-generation Blunt SS is a light, disc-only rim, 30mm wide outside and 26.6mm inside, made for XC and gravel. The Blunt 35 is a trail rim with a 30mm inner width that holds bigger MTB tyres firmly.
듀얼리(Dually)는 외폭 45mm의 와이드 림입니다. 넓은 림이 타이: The Dually is a 45mm-wide rim. The wide bed spreads the tyre out for a bigger contact patch and keeps it from folding at low pressure. A rim for loaded bikepacking and adventure bikes crossing sand and gravel.
블런트 패밀리의 세 번째 세대. 가볍고 넓은 디스크 전용 림으로 XC와: The third generation of the Blunt family. A light, wide, disc-only rim that moves between XC and gravel.
내폭 30mm의 트레일 림. 굵은 MTB 타이어의 형태를 바로 잡아 코너: A trail rim with a 30mm inner width. It shapes big MTB tyres properly for confidence in corners and descents.
외폭 45mm의 와이드 림. 두꺼운 타이어로 모래와 자갈, 눈길까지 나아: A 45mm-wide rim. A bikepacking rim that takes big tyres through sand, gravel and even snow.

브리즈번의 창고에서<br/>그랜드래피즈의 공장까지,<br/>Velocit:
From a shed in Brisbane
to a factory in Grand Rapids,
the Velocity story.
물통 케이지를 손으로 만들던 1989년의 창고에서, 알루미늄 림을 미국에: From a shed in 1989 where water bottle cages were made by hand, to today's factory making aluminum rims in the United States. Velocity moved its production across an ocean, but never let go of the principle of making its own rims and wheels.
톰 블랙이 호주 브리즈번 외곽의 뒷마당 창고에서 알루미늄 물통 케이지를: Tom Black starts making aluminum water bottle cages by hand in a backyard shed outside Brisbane, Australia.
첫 알루미늄 림 에어로(Aero)를 선보이며 림 브랜드로서의 Veloci: Velocity introduces its first aluminum rim, the Aero, and becomes a rim brand.
With John Black, Velocity opens a US distribution center in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
호주의 생산 설비를 통째로 플로리다 잭슨빌로 옮겨, 미국에서 알루미늄 림: The entire Australian production moves to Jacksonville, Florida, making Velocity one of the few aluminum rim makers in the United States.
블런트 패밀리의 세 번째 세대, 외폭 30mm의 XC 림 블런트 SS를: The third generation of the Blunt family, the 30mm-wide Blunt SS XC rim, is produced in the US factory.
모든 생산을 그랜드래피즈로 모읍니다. 림 생산부터 휠 빌드까지 한 지붕: All production moves to Grand Rapids. From rim making to wheel building, everything happens under one roof.
오랫동안 Velocity에서 일해 온 맷 루이터(Matt Ruiter)가: Matt Ruiter, a long-time Velocity employee, takes over the company from Tom Black.
좋은 휠은 림, 허브, 스포크의 조합에서 나옵니다. 루비워크샵에서 Vel: Good wheels come from the right combination of rim, hub and spokes. See Velocity rims in person at Rubi Workshop, and we will help you choose the combination and build that suit your bike and your riding.
